conclusion: Existing certified-Fs and admission checks are real but do not enforce a project-wide exposure ledger across fit, predict, cache merge and evaluation. Calendar half-year labels are insufficient; July support overlaps remain.

title: The 0.34% historical harm is not a new-panel F0 break-even theorem
conclusion: The measured 0.3392558% is normalized by historical F0 loss; Fs-relative recovery on that same panel is 0.3381088%. On another panel the break-even harm is a new paired estimate, not this fixed number.
minimal_action: Keep 0.0034 only as an explicitly chosen Fs-relative engineering screen, not a proven utility threshold. Report same-DEV paired Fs/F0/policy contrasts after prediction freeze and separate dynamic-versus-static evidence.

title: Backend/TF32 is not established as the unique cause of all Fs failures
conclusion: Certified runs are reproducible in the observed configurations; historical kernel-level causality is not isolated. H=256 fails holdout even after certified execution, while H=32 passes the 2% point-mean cap.
blocks: Unique-root-cause or universal stability claims, not use of the certified H32 Fs

title: FP05 needs a complete statistical and nested-validation contract
conclusion: Fixed N avoids one optional-stopping route but does not establish power. Bidirectional CV is retrospective, not forward-in-time deployment. Inner HPO/feature transforms and policy72 safety are unspecified.
blocks: DEV label access and positive FP06 decision
minimal_action: Freeze outer/inner folds, support purge, training-only preprocessors, fixed tie rules, paired block bootstrap, denominator, safety margin and decision sequence before outcomes. Keep confirm disabled.

title: Assembly evaluator does not itself require the full registered trace key set
conclusion: Current records contain full 1/4/12 comparisons. However, the generic numeric evaluator accepts nonempty zero maps without explicitly requiring all step keys, and all(empty boolean map) is true. This is a future-consumer robustness gap, not evidence the observed certificate skipped steps.
minimal_action: In the new wrapper require exact experts0..3, step keys1/4/12 and eight post-hold comparisons, then consume unchanged pinned certifier. No modification of the 17 certified files by default.
